observations: Black electric scooter with a large central battery pack.
Front features a 'SQUAW' brand badge and dual headlights.
Rear features a white seat and a rear luggage rack.
The scooter is equipped with a front disc brake and a rear coaster brake.
The handlebars have mirrors and a central control box.
The frame appears to be made of black tubular metal.
The tires show some dirt and wear.

claims.claim: Bought new 6 months ago. Gears and brakes perfect, no rust, all parts original.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The battery may be degraded or unable to hold a charge.
risks.proof: A video showing the scooter powered on and the display showing a full battery level.

risks.risk: The motor may be faulty or unable to accelerate.
risks.proof: A video of the scooter being ridden from a standstill to a high speed.

risks.risk: The electronic control box or charger may be missing or damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the control box and the charger.
risks.if_unproven: as missing the control box and charger

risks.risk: The rear coaster brake may not hold or may be leaking fluid.
risks.proof: A video showing the coaster brake being engaged and held.

proof_requests: Video of the scooter powered on and the battery level displayed.
Video of the scooter being ridden to demonstrate motor and braking performance.
Photo of the control box and charger.
Photo of the rear coaster brake in operation.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
